page.layout: One printed title page, centred, with lines of type from top to bottom, a small woodcut device in the middle and the printer's imprint at the foot. A library stamp at the bottom is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is heavily faded and shows strong show-through from the reverse, so most lines cannot be read. The large word HIERARCHIA is the clearest line. The imprint line "Ex officina ... Christophori Gorvini" and the Timothy reference are read with doubt. The date line beneath the imprint is not legible. The woodcut device in the centre is an engraving and has no text. The stamp of the Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München is not transcribed.
